title: Stepping Sideways to Step up: Lateral Mobility and Career Advancement Inside Organizations
eligible_reason: Matched-sample employee-level DiD around lateral moves at employee-specific years, but no reported column meets the rules: every TWFE column includes time-varying controls (firm tenure, outside experience), post x baseline job-entry-mode interactions, a 'post' main effect that also switches on for matched controls, match-group rather than individual FE, and inverse-frequency pweights; column 1 of Tables 2-3 has no fixed effects. The Callaway-Sant'Anna run (csdid) includes covariates. Confidential personnel data are not in the package.
design_notes: From 'Main analysis do file - REDACTED.do'. Data: 8 years (2009-2016) of personnel records from a U.S. healthcare company; lateral movers matched to non-movers (Match_subfunc_or_bu_laterals.txt, Python) into match groups (matchgroupnum = comptransdate x comptransid). treatment = 1 for the lateral mover; post = 1 if year > comptransdate (year of the move) for both mover and matched controls; outcomes consistentpaygrade (promotion), logtotcomp, rating_z. Tables 2-3: reghdfe y i.post##i.treatment i.post##baseprom i.post##baselat i.post##baseacq i.post##basedem i.year py_firmtenure outsideworkexperience [pweight=obswgt], absorb(matchgroupnum) vce(cluster uniqueid matchgroupnum), sample drops controls promoted/demoted in the move year and groups with maxyearsposttransfer<=0; variants with posypt (years-post) x treatment, and buexit/sfexit treatment subtypes. Appendix: csdid dlogtotcomp dpy_firmtenure doutsideworkexperience, time(year) gvar(treatyear) with mean-deviated outcome/covariates; csdid consistentpaygrade ..., reg. Appendix 2: year-by-year cross-sectional areg.
estimators_reported: TWFE-type matched DiD with match-group FE, year FE, controls and pweights (reghdfe)

ineligible_specs.reason: no unit or time fixed effects (post##treatment only, pweights)
time-varying controls (py_firmtenure, outsideworkexperience); post x entry-mode interactions; post main effect switches on for matched controls; match-group FE; pweights
CSA with time-varying covariates; outcome mean-deviated by match group
cross-sectional regressions by event year, no time FE

missing: all data (matchedlateralsfbusep20.csv and merged files; confidential company records)

screener_notes: Move years 2009-2016 imply up to 7 adoption cohorts but the exact count is not recoverable without data. The log files contain the published regression output, but no specification is eligible as reported.
